title: Prediction Markets: From Curiosity to Institutional Asset Class | Webinar Replay
summary: Galaxy explores the institutional adoption of prediction markets. Learn how event-driven markets are evolving into a new financial asset class, featuring insights on market structure, liquidity, infrastructure, and institutional use cases.
body_markdown:
Speakers:


-


**Gilbert Wassermann** , Head of Prediction Markets


-


**Michael Harvey** , Head of Franchise Trading


-


**Zane Glauber** , Global Head of Distribution


In this webinar, Galaxy's Global Markets Trading Desk discusses the emerging institutional use case for prediction markets. Our team unpacks how prediction markets work as a financial instrument, why institutions are taking notice, and what the infrastructure and opportunity set looks like today.


Learn more about Galaxy's Institutional Prediction Markets Trading offering[here](https://www.galaxy.com/prediction-markets) .
